title: Oryx MLLM: On-Demand Spatial-Temporal Understanding at Arbitrary Resolution

layout.note: A 2 x 2 grid of tinted cards split into a left pair (resolution cases) and a right pair (compression cases) by a central column holding the Oryx emblem and tagline; a group caption sits under each pair.

lesson: State a trade-off with one card per setting: repeat one card grammar (tab with the takeaway, task title, user/model dialogue, input picture with its size or duration arrow, row of token boxes with the exact count) four times, one hue each, around the model's emblem.
